question.title: Amendment No. 10: State And Local Government Structure And Operation

source.name: Florida Department of State, Division of Elections, full text of the measure (PDF linked "View Full Text" on the detail page); read in full, searched for tax, fee, levy, assess, licen*, revenue, charge, fine, penalt*

ballot_text.source_title: Ballot Number 10, Election Year 2018: State and Local Government Structure and Operation
ballot_text.type_as_read: other: revision (proposed by the Constitution Revision Commission, Revision 5; the ballot statement is headed CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT)
ballot_text.type_quote: A proposal to revise the State Constitution by the Constitution Revision Commission of Florida.

fact.quote: Requires legislature to retain department of veterans’ affairs. Ensures election of sheriffs, property appraisers, supervisors of elections, tax collectors, and clerks of court in all counties
fact.why: Revision 5 changes session dates, the Department of Veterans' Affairs, county officers and an office in the Department of Law Enforcement. The words tax collectors appear only as the name of an elected county office, and the one tax clause (Art. VIII, s. 6(h)) is existing language that limits taxation. No tax or fee is imposed. Inferred.

question.title: Amendment No. 12: Lobbying And Abuse Of Office By Public Officers

source.name: Florida Department of State, Division of Elections, full text of the measure (PDF linked "View Full Text" on the detail page); read in full, searched for tax, fee, levy, assess, licen*, revenue, charge, fine, penalt*

ballot_text.source_title: Ballot Number 12, Election Year 2018: Lobbying and Abuse of Office by Public Officers
ballot_text.type_as_read: other: revision (proposed by the Constitution Revision Commission, Revision 7; the ballot statement is headed CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT)
ballot_text.type_quote: A proposal to revise the State Constitution by the Constitution Revision Commission of Florida.

fact.quote: Expands current restrictions on lobbying for compensation by former public officers; creates restrictions on lobbying for compensation by serving public officers and former justices and judges; provides exceptions; prohibits abuse of a public position by public officers and employees to obtain a personal benefit.
fact.why: Revision 7 restricts lobbying and abuse of office; it directs the Legislature to prescribe "penalties for violations", which are not a tax or fee. Its other tax words ("ad valorem taxing authority", "federal income tax return") only describe who is covered or what a disclosure may attach. No tax or fee is imposed. Inferred.
